description: This Java source file implements the ZoneDao interface, providing database access methods for Zone entities, including listing zones filtered by language and country.

classes.name: ZoneDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ZoneDao interface, managing database operations for Zone entities with methods to list zones based on language and country filters.

methods.name: listByLanguageAndCountry
